files.description: Weekly unit sales (144 rows): region (north, south or west), channel (online, store or kiosk; the west region has no kiosk, so that pair never occurs), week (week number 1-18), units (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: Count, for each region and channel, the weeks whose unit figure is missing. List all nine region-channel combinations (regions north, south, west; channels online, store, kiosk), also those that have no rows at all (count 0); treat region and channel as categories with these fixed values. `result` should be a table with the columns region, channel and missing_weeks.
intended_computation: For all 9 combinations count rows with missing units (3 in total); combinations without rows get 0.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the applied count leaves out the combination without rows; 3.x lists it with 0

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
